name: Swan Lake RV Village
note: Park-model and RV village on US-41 (N Tamiami Trl), North Fort Myers; the transient RV loop sits south of the park-model streets. Daily $77 for RVs up to 34 ft, $88 for 35 ft+ or 50-amp, full hookups, 1-2 people ($5/day per extra). Weekly and monthly too; season stays book with a deposit by August 1. The park says Sunday and after-dark arrivals are discouraged. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Fort Myers relaxed-price mini-sweep (AWH 2026-10-05: nightly up to $150 allowed for this area only, rate stated in the note). Operator rate page (swanlakevillage.com rate-information, read 2026-10-05): daily $77 (RVs to 34 ft) / $88 (35 ft+ and all 50 A), full hookups. AWH 2026-10-05 located a regular campground loop south of the park-model area at 26.697355,-81.885992 (satellite confirms two rows of RVs on a grass loop). RV Life 4.5*/$$$ (14 reviews); Google 4.7 over 113
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 26.697355,-81.885992: the RV loop is bounded by park models to the north and a power-line corridor and treeline to the south; the nearest pond is in the neighbouring community beyond the treeline - not waterfront
